description: This file defines an interface for a semaphore synchronization primitive in C. It includes declarations for creating, destroying, posting, retrieving the value of, and waiting on semaphores, along with relevant documentation comments.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Create
methods.description: Creates an unnamed semaphore with initial value 0.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Post
methods.description: Increments the semaphore value by 1 and wakes waiting threads.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the semaphore.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Wait
methods.description: Blocks until the semaphore is greater than zero.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_TimedWait
methods.description: Waits for the semaphore with a timeout specified by a timespec.
